!  1. aaa      ACCESS     missing: AAA is not turned on (aaa new-model). Fixed by region line 3.
!  2. aaa      ACCESS     missing: tacacs server TACACS: 4 statements (e.g. tacacs server TACACS >
!                         address ipv4 192.0.2.10). Fixed by region lines 5-8.
!  3. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the server group LAB-TACACS: server name TACACS (aaa group server
!                         tacacs+ LAB-TACACS > server name TACACS). Fixed by region line 10.
!  4. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the default login method list (aaa authentication login default
!                         local group LAB-TACACS). Fixed by region line 11.
!  5. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the default exec authorization list (without it every new login
!                         lands at privilege 1) (aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS
!                         if-authenticated). Fixed by region line 12.
!  6. aaa      COSMETIC   missing: accounting: 5 statements (e.g. aaa accounting exec default
!                         start-stop group LAB-TACACS). Fixed by region lines 13-17.
!  7. aaa      ACCESS     missing: command authorization: 4 statements (e.g. aaa authorization
!                         commands 1 default local group LAB-TACACS). Fixed by region lines 46-49.
!  8. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the login method of line con 0: login authentication default (line
!                         con 0 > login authentication default). Follows from 'aaa new-model': lines
!                         with no login method use the default list.
!  9. aaa      ACCESS     different: the login method of line vty 0 15: login authentication default
!                         (the device has: the login method of line vty 0 4: login local) (line vty 0
!                         15 > login authentication default). Fixed by region line 19.
! 10. roles    COSMETIC   missing: level 1 may run show running-config (privilege exec level 1 show
!                         running-config). Fixed by region line 21.
! 11. roles    COSMETIC   missing: the commands of privilege level 7: 9 statements (e.g. privilege
!                         exec all level 7 ping). Fixed by region lines 22-30.
! 12. snmp     MONITORING missing: ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP: 3 statements (e.g. ip
!                         access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP > permit 192.0.2.10). Fixed by region lines
!                         33-35.
! 13. snmp     MONITORING missing: an SNMP community (snmp-server community <secret> RO TACCTL-SNMP).
!                         Fixed by region line 36.
! 14. snmp     COSMETIC   missing: the SNMP location is Rack 4, DC1 (snmp-server location Rack 4,
!                         DC1). Fixed by region line 37.

!                         <noc@example.net>). Fixed by region line 38.

!                         standard VTY-ACL > permit 192.0.2.10). Fixed by region lines 41-44.

! Not planned: netconf, breakglass.
! WARNING: the block switches command authorization on ('aaa authorization commands',
! 'config-commands') with its last lines: from then on every command is authorized by the server, so
! paste it as a user the server knows (or with local first), and keep the second terminal for the
! back-out.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the
! echo for '% Invalid'. Pasting the region twice is harmless.
!
! Type this first, on dev-cisco-reference-bare, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
!
!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-reference-bare !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the server, the group and the method lists tacctl renders
aaa new-model
tacacs server TACACS
 address ipv4 192.0.2.10
 key lab-secret-0123456789abcdef
 single-connection
 timeout 5
aaa group server tacacs+ LAB-TACACS
 server name TACACS
aaa authentication login default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authorization exec default local group LAB-TACACS if-authenticated
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 1 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 5 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 7 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group LAB-TACACS
line vty 0 4
 login authentication default
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec level 1 show running-config
privilege exec all level 7 ping
privilege exec all level 7 traceroute
privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
privilege exec level 7 clear counters
privilege exec level 7 clear line
privilege exec level 7 clear ip arp
privilege exec level 7 clear arp-cache
privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
privilege exec level 7 undebug all
! snmp: the community tacctl renders, retyped as rendered
ip access-list standard TACCTL-SNMP
 permit host 192.0.2.10
 permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any
snmp-server community lab-ro-community RO TACCTL-SNMP
snmp-server location Rack 4, DC1
snmp-server contact NOC <noc@example.net>
! mgmt-acl: the management access list tacctl renders (its entries and their order)
ip access-list standard VTY-ACL
 permit 192.0.2.10 0.0.0.0
 permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any log
! aaa: command authorization, last on purpose
aaa authorization commands 1 default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authorization commands 7 default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authorization commands 15 default local group LAB-TACACS
aaa authorization config-commands
end
